name: json-schema-compliance-benchmark
description:
JSON Schema Compliance Benchmark
	

A 500-example benchmark for evaluating whether language models can generate valid JSON conforming to provided schemas. Designed with strict contamination prevention to test generalization, not memorization.

	
		
		Purpose
	

This is the primary Tier 1 evaluation metric for the Trellis SFT project. It measures a model's ability to produce structured output that passes jsonschema.validate() against novel, niche-domain schemas the model has never seen… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mdonigian/json-schema-compliance-benchmark.
reputation: A niche but well-designed benchmark used by Trellis SFT for structured-output evaluation; modest adoption outside the project.
